which signifies both first-produced and first-producing, because nothing was born before him, but all
things have proceeded from him. Primogenial Love is represented in antiques mounted on the back of
a lion, and being of Egyptian origin, is traced by the modern astronomical interpreters of mythology
to the Leo of the Zodiac.’ (Peacock Works vii 91)
